COA, PDS & SDS
TECHNICAL DOCUMENTS FOR BITUMEN PROCUREMENT

LAST REVIEWED SEPTEMBER 10, 2026 · PETROBIND EXPORT DESK

Technical documents help procurement teams qualify bitumen before commitment. PetroBind supports buyers with document-led supply: product data sheet for typical values, certificate of analysis for batch values, and safety data sheets for handling control.

Request Bitumen Quote
View Bitumen Grades
COA CONFIRMS THE SHIPMENT BATCH

A Certificate of Analysis records actual tested values for the relevant lot or batch. Buyers should review penetration, softening point, ductility, flash point, solubility, viscosity, and residue values depending on the grade and project specification.

PDS SUPPORTS PRODUCT EVALUATION

A Product Data Sheet gives the typical technical profile, application fit, storage guidance, and grade identity. It is useful during tender evaluation, but the final shipment should still be checked against batch-specific COA values.

TEST METHOD ALIGNMENT MATTERS

PetroBind frames product offers around recognized ASTM, ISO, and EN method references so buyers can compare values consistently across suppliers and origins.

Penetration grade bitumen commonly references penetration, softening point, ductility, flash point, and solubility tests.

Oxidized bitumen is commonly reviewed by softening point and penetration value.

Bitumen emulsion documents may include residue, viscosity, storage stability, and particle charge data.
